headline: Google's Demis Hassabis wants global AI watchdog led by the US
summary: Proposal for a global AI regulator to mitigate risks of advanced AI systems
details: Demis Hassabis, Google DeepMind CEO, proposes a global AI watchdog led by the US to regulate frontier AI models. The organization would evaluate models before release and coordinate industry-wide slowdowns if needed.
Hassabis believes the US is the best place to set global standards due to its economic and technical standing. The watchdog could resemble existing regulators like FINRA.
The proposal aims to address growing concerns about AI safety and potential risks. Hassabis has been building support for the idea, including briefing the Trump administration and European officials.
caption:
Can a global AI watchdog prevent AI disasters? Google's Demis Hassabis thinks so.

Demis Hassabis, Google DeepMind CEO, proposes a global AI watchdog led by the US to regulate frontier AI models. The organization would evaluate models before release and coordinate industry-wide slowdowns if needed.

Hassabis believes the US is the best place to set global standards due to its economic and technical standing. The watchdog could resemble existing regulators like FINRA.

The proposal aims to address growing concerns about AI safety and potential risks. Hassabis has been building support for the idea, including briefing the Trump administration and European officials.
